verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for an agent-building SDK, but the evidence documents no rule engine or trigger mechanism that fires actions automatically on events. Guardrails (input/output validation), streaming run updates, tracing of run events, and tool-approval interruptions are adjacent features, not user-defined event→action rules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
